instrument.label: menu observation
steps: The candidate is already installed. The menu is not open yet.
Hold SHIFT to access the secondary pad functions.
Press pad 13 while holding SHIFT to open Utility.
The expected title appears: CUSTOM MENU!
Release the controls. This reconstructs the owner's reported observation.

memory.label: runtime regions
steps: Three operations build different kinds of runtime regions.
Copy: stored bytes arrive unchanged at their destination.
Expand: a compact representation produces a longer sequence.
Zero-fill: empty runtime state is created without stored payload bytes.
The operations explain why a file offset is not a runtime address.

code.label: title reference
steps: Start with recognizable text: UTILITY MENU.
The string's cross-reference leads to this function.
aUtilityMenu is passed as the title argument to a drawing call.
SYSTEM appears in the same routine, corroborating the menu's identity.
A reference connects the text to a consumer; execution tests check that route.

comparison.label: title byte comparison
steps: Compare twelve printable ASCII bytes and one zero terminator.
12 changed bytes. The zero terminator and total length are unchanged.

verification.label: CPU test report
steps: Replay the saved results: two images across six menu selections.
12 of 12 recorded CPU cases passed. Hardware was a separate check.
